arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ، وَاللهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُمَّ مِنْكَ وَلَكَ، اللَّهُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ مِنِّي.
transliteration: Bismillaah, wallaahu akbar, Allahumma minka wa lak, Allahumma taqabbal minnee.
translation: In the Name of Allah, and Allah is the Most Great. O Allah, it is from You and to You. O Allah, accept it from me.
